college.name: Sphoorthy Engineering College
college.ranking: 9th among Private Engineering Colleges in Telangana (Times Engineering Survey 2026)
college.address: Nadargul Village, Near B.N. Reddy Nagar, Saroornagar Mandal, Sagar Road, Ranga Reddy District, Hyderabad, Telangana - 501510

departments.name: Computer Science and Engineering
departments.description: Flagship department offering cutting-edge curriculum in programming, algorithms, databases, AI, cloud computing, and software engineering.

departments.name: CSE - Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning
departments.description: Specialized branch focusing on machine learning, deep learning, neural networks, NLP, computer vision, and AI applications.

departments.name: CSE - Data Science
departments.description: Focuses on big data analytics, data mining, statistical modeling, data visualization, and business intelligence.

departments.name: CSE - Cyber Security
departments.description: Specializes in network security, ethical hacking, cryptography, digital forensics, and cyber defense strategies.

departments.name: Electronics and Communication Engineering
departments.description: Covers electronic circuits, communication systems, VLSI design, embedded systems, signal processing, and IoT.

departments.name: Civil Engineering
departments.description: Focuses on structural engineering, geotechnical engineering, transportation, environmental engineering, and construction management.

departments.name: Mechanical Engineering
departments.description: Covers thermodynamics, fluid mechanics, manufacturing, robotics, automobile engineering, and CAD/CAM.

departments.name: Master of Business Administration
departments.description: 2-year postgraduate management program covering marketing, finance, HR, operations, and entrepreneurship.

courses.name: Lateral Entry B.Tech
courses.eligibility: Diploma / B.Sc holders via TG ECET

convener_quota.process: Online state counseling based on EAPCET rank

management_quota.process: Direct admission by college based on 10+2 merit, JEE Main, or EAPCET rank

facilities.name: Computer Labs
facilities.description: State-of-the-art computer centers with latest hardware and software, high-speed internet, and 24/7 access for students.

facilities.name: Central Library
facilities.description: Houses 45,000+ volumes, IEEE e-journals digital library, national/international research journal subscriptions, and spacious reading halls.

facilities.name: Girls' Hostel
facilities.description: On-campus spacious and secure hostel with attached dining facility, gym, round-the-clock security, and power backup.

facilities.name: Sports Complex
facilities.description: Outdoor courts for Cricket, Football, Volleyball, Basketball. Indoor facilities for Badminton, Table Tennis, Chess, Carroms. Active Sankalp Sports Club.

facilities.name: Wi-Fi Campus
facilities.description: 24/7 high-speed Wi-Fi connectivity across the entire 25-acre campus.

facilities.name: Canteen & Cafeteria
facilities.description: Central cafeteria and hostel dining hall providing hygienic vegetarian and non-vegetarian food at affordable prices.

facilities.name: Transport
facilities.description: Fleet of dedicated college buses covering major routes across Hyderabad and Secunderabad. Free for staff, subsidized for students.

facilities.name: AI/ML Research Lab
facilities.description: Dedicated research laboratory for Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning projects with GPU workstations.

facilities.name: IoT Lab
facilities.description: Internet of Things laboratory with Arduino, Raspberry Pi, sensors, and embedded systems development kits.

facilities.name: Seminar Halls
facilities.description: Multiple air-conditioned seminar halls and auditorium with modern AV equipment for workshops, guest lectures, and events.

facilities.name: Health Center
facilities.description: On-campus health center with first-aid facilities and medical support for students and staff.

facilities.name: Yoga Studio
facilities.description: Dedicated yoga studio for physical and mental wellness of students.

facilities.name: Gymnasium
facilities.description: Fully equipped gym facility available for students and staff fitness.

facilities.name: Parking Facility
facilities.description: Spacious and organized parking area for students, staff, and visitors.

facilities.name: Green Initiatives
facilities.description: Eco-friendly campus with solar panels, rainwater harvesting, and plantation drives.

facilities.name: AICTE Idea Lab
facilities.description: AICTE-sponsored innovation lab for students to prototype, build, and test creative ideas and projects.

facilities.name: Girls Waiting Hall
facilities.description: Comfortable and secure waiting area exclusively for girl students.

scholarships.name: Telangana ePASS Fee Reimbursement
scholarships.description: Government of Telangana tuition fee reimbursement for SC, ST, BC, EBC, and Minority category students.

scholarships.name: Merit Scholarships
scholarships.description: Institutional merit awards for academic toppers in each branch.

scholarships.name: Sports Quota Concession
scholarships.description: Fee concessions for students with state/national level sports achievements.
scholarships.eligibility: State or national level sports certificates

scholarships.name: Single Girl Child Support
scholarships.description: Special fee concession for single girl child students.
scholarships.eligibility: Single girl child with relevant documentation

scholarships.name: Defense Personnel Ward
scholarships.description: Concessions for children of defense personnel.

events.name: PRAZASTI
events.description: Flagship annual national-level technical fest featuring Hackathons, Ideathons, Project Expos, Paper & Poster Presentations, and Coding competitions.

events.name: SAMISTI
events.description: Annual cultural celebration featuring music, dance, drama, and cultural showcases.

events.name: Engineers' Day
events.description: Celebrated on September 15 with technical activities honoring Sir M. Visvesvaraya.

events.name: Freshers' Day
events.description: Welcome celebration for newly admitted students.

clubs: Art and Quill (Literary & Fine Arts Club)

academic_system.evaluation: Continuous Internal (Mid-I, Mid-II, assignments, practicals) + End-Semester Examinations
academic_system.curriculum: Industry-aligned, updated periodically with Board of Studies (BoS) comprising JNTUH nominees and industry experts
